phase: Phase 2: Finance & Operational Control (Accounting, Payroll, Auditing, and Compliance)

pillars.name: Double-Entry Accounting & Automated Commercial Bridges
capabilities: Standardized Chart of Accounts (Assets 1000s, Liabilities 2000s, Equity 3000s, Revenue 4000s, COGS 5000s, Expenses 6000s, Variance 8000s)
POS Sale -> Automated balanced journal (Cash/AR + COGS Dr = Sales Revenue + VAT + Inventory Cr)
Goods Receipt -> Automated balanced journal (Inventory Asset Dr = Accounts Payable Cr)
Operating Expense -> Automated balanced journal (Expense Dr = Cash/Bank Cr)
Cash Drawer Variance -> Automated balanced journal (Cash Short/Over Dr/Cr = Cash Cr/Dr)
Sales Return -> Automated balanced journal (Sales Returns Dr = Cash Cr, Inventory restored for GOOD condition)
Accounts Receivable & Payable aging bucket categorization (Current, 1-30, 31-60, 61-90, 90+ days)
Financial Period Close immutability (closed periods reject late/subsequent postings with INVARIANT_F010_VIOLATION)
Non-destructive reversing journal generation with audit link

pillars.name: Payroll, Statutory Deductions & Labor Costing Bridge
capabilities: Approved Timesheet gross pay calculation with regular hours and overtime multipliers
Sales commissions and bonus/allowance aggregation from commercial operations
Statutory deduction accounting (PAYE withholding and pension/social security)
PayrollPostingBridge translating approved payroll into balanced GL journal (Salaries Expense Dr = PAYE Withholding + Net Salaries Payable Cr)
Consolidated batch payroll run journal generation
Net salary disbursement clearing Net Salaries Payable and crediting Bank/Cash

pillars.name: Cryptographic Audit Trail & Forensic Verification
capabilities: Sequential immutable audit logging across financial, commercial, and workforce actions
Cryptographic SHA-256 hash chaining (previousHash -> currentHash)
Continuous audit chain integrity verification (verifyAuditChain)
Fail-closed tamper detection identifying corrupted or malicious audit record alterations

pillars.name: Statutory Compliance & Regulatory Framework
capabilities: TRA EFDMS fiscal device / virtual fiscal device signature compliance rule evaluation
Tanzania Data Protection Act & GDPR customer PII protection and erasure audit verification
Compliance health summary scorecards (ComplianceHealthSummary)
Zero open critical compliance or security vulnerabilities
